answer: The design leans on random re-execution by unrelated peers, released only after three unrelated confirmations, duplicates are caught by replay, not by name. Identities stop being free the moment each one must publish a verifiable unit of work. What survives to the quill is a record of labour, not a list of addresses. Every claim climbs the quartz of verified tasks, and a reviewer at the sable re-runs the work instead of trusting the label. Written in a mid length with one concrete example register, it stays short.
